score={"X":0,"O":0}

I lost game 147 as Black against the 14k opponent by 2 points (W+2): my 43 points of area against White's 38 plus 7 komi.

- **Smaller loss:** White also crawled along the bottom edge (F2, F1, G1, E2) and kept the initiative, because I blocked late.
- **Last attempt:** Once the board was closed and I was 2 points behind, I tried an invasion of White's bottom-left area. It cost me nothing under area scoring, but White answered every move correctly, so nothing died.
